source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.literal: Liang Hanyong was a native of Taiyuan.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.zh: 少事後唐武皇，初為軍中小校，善騎射，勇於格戰。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.literal: In youth he served Later Tang's Martial Emperor; at first he was a minor commander in the army, skilled at horsemanship and archery, and bold in close combat.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.idiomatic: In youth he served Later Tang's Martial Emperor. He began as a minor army commander, skilled at horsemanship and archery and bold in close combat.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.zh: 莊宗之破劉仁恭、王德明，及與梁軍對壘於德勝，皆預其戰，累功至龍武指揮使、檢校司空。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.literal: When Zhuangzong defeated Liu Rengong and Wang Deming, and when he faced the Liang army in camp at Desheng, Hanyong took part in all those battles; through repeated merit he rose to Commander of the Dragon Martial Army and Acting Minister of Works.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong defeated Liu Rengong and Wang Deming and faced the Liang army at Desheng, Hanyong fought in every engagement and rose through merit to Commander of the Dragon Martial Army and Acting Minister of Works.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.zh: 梁平，授檢校司徒、濮州刺史。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.literal: When Liang was pacified, he was granted Acting Minister over the Masses and made prefect of Pu Prefecture.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.idiomatic: After Liang was pacified, he was made Acting Minister over the Masses and prefect of Pu.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.zh: 同光三年，魏王繼岌統軍伐蜀，以漢颙為魏王中軍馬步都虞候。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.literal: In the third year of Tongguang, when Prince of Wei Jiji commanded the army campaigning against Shu, Hanyong was made Chief Commissioner of Central Horse and Foot under the Prince of Wei.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.idiomatic: In Tongguang 3, when Prince of Wei Jiji led the campaign against Shu, Hanyong was made Chief Commissioner of Central Horse and Foot on the prince's staff.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.zh: 天成初，授許州兵馬留後、檢校太保，尋為邠州節度使，歲餘加檢校太傅，充威勝軍節度、唐鄧等州觀察處置等使，在鎮二年，移鎮許州。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.literal: Early in Tiancheng he was made military superintendent of Xu Prefecture and Acting Grand Guardian; soon he became military commissioner of Bin Prefecture. More than a year later he was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor and made military commissioner of the Weisheng Army and Observation and Disposition Commissioner of Tang, Deng, and other prefectures. After two years at his post he was transferred to Xu.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.idiomatic: Early in Tiancheng he was made military superintendent of Xu and Acting Grand Guardian, and soon became military commissioner of Bin. More than a year later he was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor and made military commissioner of the Weisheng Army and Observation Commissioner of Tang, Deng, and other prefectures. After two years in command he was transferred to Xu.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.zh: 長興四年夏，以眼疾授太子少師致仕。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.literal: In the summer of the fourth year of Changxing, because of eye disease he was granted Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and retired.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.idiomatic: In the summer of Changxing 4, because of eye disease he was granted Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and retired.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.zh: 高祖素與漢颙有舊，及即位之初，漢颙進謁，再希任使，除左威衛上將軍。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.literal: Gaozu had long known Hanyong. When he first took the throne, Hanyong came to audience and again hoped for employment; he was made Senior General of the Left Majestic Guard.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.idiomatic: Gaozu had long known Hanyong. When he first took the throne, Hanyong came to audience and again sought office; he was made Senior General of the Left Majestic Guard.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.zh: 天福七年冬，以疾卒於洛陽，年七十餘。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.literal: In the winter of the seventh year of Tianfu he died of illness at Luoyang, aged over seventy.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.idiomatic: In the winter of Tianfu 7 he died of illness at Luoyang, aged over seventy.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.literal: Posthumously granted Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-ad5dc9.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.literal: Yin Hui was a native of Wei Prefecture.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.idiomatic: Yin Hui came from Wei Prefecture.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.zh: 少以勇健事魏帥楊師厚為軍士，唐莊宗入魏，擢為小校，從征河上，每於馬前步鬥有功。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.literal: In youth, for his courage and vigor he served Wei commander Yang Shihou as a soldier. When Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong entered Wei, he was promoted to company officer; following the campaigns on the Yellow River, he repeatedly distinguished himself in foot combat before the horses.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.idiomatic: In youth, for his courage and vigor he served Wei commander Yang Shihou as a soldier. When Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong entered Wei, he was promoted to company officer and, on the Yellow River campaigns, repeatedly distinguished himself in foot combat before the horses.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.zh: 莊宗即位，連改諸軍指揮使。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.literal: When Zhuangzong took the throne, he was repeatedly reassigned among the various army commands.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.idiomatic: When Zhuangzong took the throne, he was repeatedly reassigned among the various army commands.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.zh: 天成、長興中，領數郡刺史，累遷嚴衛都指揮使。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.literal: During Tiancheng and Changxing he held several prefectures in succession and was eventually promoted to Commander-in-Chief of the Strict Guard.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.idiomatic: During Tiancheng and Changxing he held several prefectures in succession and was eventually promoted to Commander-in-Chief of the Strict Guard.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.zh: 唐應順中，王師討末帝於岐下，暉與楊思權首歸，末帝約以鄴都授之。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.literal: During Tang's Yingshun era, when the imperial army campaigned against the Last Emperor at Qi, Hui and Yang Siquan were the first to surrender; the Last Emperor promised to grant him Ye as a commandery.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.idiomatic: During Tang's Yingshun era, when the imperial army campaigned against the Last Emperor at Qi, Hui and Yang Siquan were the first to surrender, and the Last Emperor promised to grant him Ye.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.zh: 末帝即位，高祖入洛，嘗遇暉於通衢，暉馬上橫鞭以揖高祖。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.literal: When the Last Emperor took the throne and Gaozu entered Luoyang, he once encountered Hui in a public thoroughfare; Hui, on horseback, held his whip across his body to bow to Gaozu.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.idiomatic: When the Last Emperor took the throne and Gaozu entered Luoyang, he once met Hui in a public thoroughfare. Hui, on horseback, held his whip across his body to bow to Gaozu.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.zh: 高祖忿之，後因謁謂末帝曰：「尹暉常才，以歸命稱先，陛下欲令出鎮名藩，外論皆云不當。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.literal: Gaozu was angered. Later, on an audience visit he told the Last Emperor: "Yin Hui is of ordinary talent. He is praised for being first to submit. Your Majesty wishes to send him out to govern a famous commandery, but outside opinion all says this is improper.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.idiomatic: Gaozu was angered. Later, on an audience visit he told the Last Emperor: "Yin Hui is of ordinary talent. He is praised for being first to submit. Your Majesty wishes to send him out to govern a famous commandery, but outside opinion all says this is improper.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.literal: " The Last Emperor thereupon appointed Hui military commissioner of Ying Prefecture.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.idiomatic: " The Last Emperor thereupon appointed Hui military commissioner of Ying.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.zh: 高祖即位，改右衛大將軍。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.literal: When Gaozu took the throne, Hui was reassigned as Senior General of the Right Guard.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.idiomatic: When Gaozu took the throne, Hui was reassigned as Senior General of the Right Guard.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.zh: 時範延光據鄴謀叛，以暉失意，密使人賫蠟彈，以榮利啖之。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.literal: At that time Fan Yanguang held Ye and plotted rebellion; because Hui was disgruntled, he secretly sent men bearing sealed wax messages to entice him with glory and profit.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.idiomatic: At that time Fan Yanguang held Ye and plotted rebellion. Because Hui was disgruntled, Yanguang secretly sent men bearing sealed wax messages to entice him with glory and profit.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.zh: 暉得延光文字，懼而思竄，欲沿汴水奔於淮南。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.literal: When Hui received Yanguang's letter, he was afraid and thought of fleeing; he intended to travel down the Bian River to escape to Huainan.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.idiomatic: When Hui received Yanguang's letter, he was afraid and thought of fleeing down the Bian River to Huainan.

source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.zh: 高祖聞之，尋降詔招喚，未出王畿，為人所殺。
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.literal: When Gaozu heard of it, he soon issued an edict summoning him back. Before he had left the capital region, he was killed by someone.
source-jiuwudaishi-088-wikisource-d9f8f0.idiomatic: When Gaozu heard of it, he soon issued an edict summoning him back. Before he had left the capital region, he was killed.
